result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the system home indicator overlaps the bottom navigation bar icons due to missing safe-area bottom padding.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar lacks bottom safe-area inset padding, causing the navigation icons to sit too close to the bottom screen edge and the system home indicator bar to directly overlap the search and orders icons.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the navigation bar container using safe-area insets (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) so the tab icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
